facts.why: Baxter Cain owns the Dallas Felons, a rival team. Ted Denslow owns the Milwaukee Beers, and after his death Coop holds ownership for a year. It is not printed on this layout.
facts.fix: Baxter Cain, owner of the Dallas Felons

vibe.verdict: The scoreboard and ticket make a fun stadium and the beer-and-cheese food fits Milwaukee, but the film's dumbest, best gags are mostly missing.
missing: Denslow choking on a hot dog at the championship
The La-Z-Boy ball popping and the Barcalounger replacement
The Dude, Dude, Dude exchange between Coop and Remer
Squeak's speech about the Malaka-Laka board
The psych-out rule (only used in a dish name)
Cain's clothing line scandal in Calcutta
ideas: Swap 'Hot buffalo wings' note for 'Ted Denslow's last hot dog' with a choke warning.
Swap 'Driveway hot fudge peanut sundaes' note for 'Served in a La-Z-Boy bowl'.
Swap the scorecard 'Now serving: snacks' for 'Dude. Dude. Dude'.
Swap 'Ice cold Milwaukee lager' note for 'Malaka-Laka board, seven inning stretch round'.
